title: First Session: Install and Launch Claude Code
description: Four commands take you from a fresh machine to a running Claude Code session: confirm Node 20+, install the package globally, change into your project directory, and launch with authentication.

steps.description: The block shows the complete first-session sequence: node version check, global npm install, project directory change, and claude launch.
Line 3 is the most common beginner error: launching from ~ instead of the project directory grants the agent your entire home directory.

steps.question: What does the comment on line 3 warn against?
steps.answer: launching from ~ and granting an agent your entire home directory

steps.description: Line 4 launches the tool and prompts for authentication on first run; this is the only interactive step in the sequence.
